novel_features.name: Company compare
novel_features.description: See two to four companies' fundamentals side by side (valuation, margins, growth, insider activity) without tab-switching.
novel_features.rationale: No single Screener.in endpoint returns a cross-company comparison; the side-by-side view requires joining the local financials and trades mirror.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this when an agent needs to decide between candidate stocks on comparable fundamentals instead of fetching pages one at a time.

novel_features.name: Quarterly trend
novel_features.description: Spot whether a company's quarterly profit/sales growth is accelerating or deteriorating, with YOY change and margin drift computed automatically.
novel_features.rationale: Screener.in renders a wide raw HTML table; the YOY-change and consecutive-decline flags require local computation over the synced quarterly table.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this when an agent needs the trend shape of a company's earnings, not just the latest quarter's raw numbers.

novel_features.name: Screen overlap
novel_features.description: Find companies that appear in two or more stock screens in one command, replacing spreadsheet dedup.
novel_features.rationale: Screens are separate paginated HTML tables; intersecting them by symbol is a cross-screen join no single page provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this when an agent needs the intersection of multiple screening strategies to find high-conviction candidates.

novel_features.name: Screen rank
novel_features.description: Re-score a screen's companies with a composite of fundamentals (P/E, ROCE, growth), sorted by what matters to you.
novel_features.rationale: Joining screen membership with cached fundamentals produces a composite rank no endpoint provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this when an agent should prioritize within a screen by fundamentals or insider conviction rather than the default table order.

novel_features.name: Insider flow
novel_features.description: Answer 'who is net buying the most this month?' with per-company insider buy/sell aggregation.
novel_features.rationale: The insider-trades endpoint returns chronological rows; net per-company flows require local aggregation over the synced trades table.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this when an agent needs insider conviction ranked by net value, not a raw list of individual trades.

narrative.headline: Every Screener.in feature, plus offline search, screen intersections, and a local fundamentals mirror no other tool has.
narrative.value_prop: Search any Indian company and pull its full fundamental profile — key metrics, machine-generated pros/cons, quarterly results, P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, ratios, shareholding, peers, and price charts — from the terminal. Sync company pages, screens, and insider trades into a local SQLite mirror, then run cross-company comparisons, quarterly trend flags, screen overlaps, and insider-flow rankings that no single page or API call provides.
narrative.auth_narrative: Screener.in's public pages (company profiles, screens, sectors, IPO) need no login. Market-pulse pages — latest quarterly results, insider trades, filings — require a free Screener.in account. Run 'screener-pp-cli auth login --chrome' to import your logged-in Chrome session cookie once; the CLI replays it for gated pages.

quickstart.comment: Find the company ID and symbol

troubleshoots.symptom: results/trades commands redirect to a register page
troubleshoots.fix: You are not logged in. Run the 'auth login' command with the Chrome option with your Screener.in session, or 'screener-pp-cli auth status' to check.
Screener.in throttles bulk access. Wait a few minutes and retry, or use 'sync --since' to cache data locally and query offline.

troubleshoots.symptom: HTML table parse produces empty rows
troubleshoots.fix: Screener.in occasionally changes table markup. Re-sync with 'screener-pp-cli sync --full' and report the page URL if parsing still fails.

troubleshoots.symptom: Commands fail with unexpected errors or empty output
troubleshoots.fix: Run 'screener-pp-cli doctor' to verify connectivity and auth, then retry. For auth-gated pages, run the 'auth login' command with the Chrome option to re-import your session.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for Indian equity fundamental research: checking a company's full profile, screening the market by a strategy, comparing candidates, monitoring quarterly earnings trends, tracking insider activity, and building a local fundamentals mirror for offline or agent-driven analysis.
anti_triggers: Do not use for intraday price action or live quotes — Screener.in data updates at market close, not real time
Do not use for option chain or derivatives data — Screener.in covers equities only
Do not use for US or non-Indian markets — Screener.in covers NSE/BSE listed companies
